  (check-type calendar holiday-calendar)

  (values (gethash (date-day-number date) (holiday-table calendar))))

;;; Public holidays. Hourly employees who work on one are paid the
;;; holiday rate for those hours; see the pay rules.

(defclass holiday-calendar ()
  ((table :initform (make-hash-table)
          :reader holiday-table
          :documentation "Holiday names by day number."))
  (:documentation "A set of dates, each the holiday of some name."))

(defun make-holiday-calendar ()
  "Returns an empty holiday calendar."
  (make-instance 'holiday-calendar))

(defun add-holiday (calendar date name)
  "Makes DATE the holiday NAME in CALENDAR, replacing the name it had if
it was one already, and returns CALENDAR."
  (check-type calendar holiday-calendar)
  (check-type date date)
  (check-type name string)
  (setf (gethash (date-day-number date) (holiday-table calendar)) name)
  calendar)

(defun holiday-name (calendar date)
  "Returns the name of the holiday on DATE in CALENDAR, or NIL if DATE
is not a holiday."
  (check-type calendar holiday-calendar)
  (check-type date date)

  (print-unreadable-object (calendar stream :type t)
    (format stream "~D holiday~:P" (hash-table-count (holiday-table calendar)))))

(in-package #:timesheet)

;;; Public holidays. A calendar maps dates to the names of the holidays
;;; on them; the pay rules hold one, and hourly employees are paid the
;;; holiday rate for the hours they work on those dates.

(defclass holiday-calendar ()
  ((holidays :initform (make-hash-table)
             :reader holiday-table
             :documentation "Holiday names by day number."))
  (:documentation "The public holidays: dates and their names."))

(defun make-holiday-calendar ()
  "Returns an empty holiday calendar."
  (make-instance 'holiday-calendar))

(defun add-holiday (calendar date name)
  "Makes DATE the holiday NAME in CALENDAR, replacing any name it had,
and returns CALENDAR."
  (check-type date date)
  (check-type name string)
  (setf (gethash (date-day-number date) (holiday-table calendar)) name)
  calendar)

(defun holiday-name (calendar date)
  "Returns the name of the holiday on DATE in CALENDAR, or NIL if DATE
is not a holiday."
  (values (gethash (date-day-number date) (holiday-table calendar))))

(defmethod print-object ((calendar holiday-calendar) stream)
  (print-unreadable-object (calendar stream :type t)
    (format stream "~D holiday~:P" (hash-table-count (holiday-table calendar)))))
EOF

(in-package #:timesheet)

;;; Public holidays. Hourly employees are paid a holiday rate for the
;;; hours they work on one.

(defclass holiday-calendar ()
  ((holidays :initform (make-hash-table)
             :reader holiday-table
             :documentation "Holiday names by day number."))
  (:documentation "The public holidays, by date."))

(defun make-holiday-calendar ()
  "Returns a calendar with no holidays."
  (make-instance 'holiday-calendar))

(defun add-holiday (calendar date name)
  "Makes DATE the holiday NAME in CALENDAR and returns CALENDAR. A date
that is already a holiday gets the new name."
  (check-type date date)
  (check-type name string)
  (setf (gethash (date-day-number date) (holiday-table calendar)) name)
  calendar)

(defun holiday-name (calendar date)
  "Returns the name of the holiday on DATE in CALENDAR, or NIL if DATE
is not a holiday."
  (values (gethash (date-day-number date) (holiday-table calendar))))

(defmethod print-object ((calendar holiday-calendar) stream)
  (print-unreadable-object (calendar stream :type t)
    (format stream "~D holiday~:P" (hash-table-count (holiday-table calendar)))))
